scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w mobile
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w mobile
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build -w mobile && npm exec -w mobile -- cap sync android
